note: 断言称双宾语代词与单个反身代词遵循相同的位置规则，目标文章spanish-reflexive-verbs原文明确支持：'Placement follows the same rule as direct and indirect object pronouns: the pronoun goes immediately before a conjugated verb (*Me levanto*), and attaches to the end of an infinitive, a gerund, or an affirmative command... Negative commands put it back in front'，与桥接句'same placement pattern...immediately in front of a conjugated verb'的描述一致。
